summary: Silicon Motion Technology Corporation filed a Form 6-K with a press release confirming its previously announced quarterly cash dividend of $0.50 per ADS (equivalent to $0.125 per ordinary share), to be paid on August 20, 2026 to holders of record on August 6, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. The filing contains no terms regarding an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. It is a standard periodic report on dividend procedures.
